name: imagify-fullstack
description: AI Image Generation SaaS - Full Stack Application

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm run dev to start both servers'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && cd server && rm -rf node_modules && cd ../client && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.clean:windows: if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules && cd server && if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules && cd ../client && if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install-all
scripts.reset:windows: npm run clean:windows && npm run install-all
